title: UNS message envelope, contract version 1
description: Every payload on the Unified Namespace is UTF-8 JSON in this envelope (docs/UNS_CONTRACT.md, section 3). Each message schema in this folder refines it. Unknown properties are allowed, because adding an optional field is not a version change (section 5).

schema.description: The message type and its version, e.g. operation-performance/v1. A consumer ignores schemas it does not know.

event_id.description: The idempotency key (ADR 0010). Required on events, optional (null) on retained state.

source.description: Who published the message, e.g. erp-intelligence, mes-intelligence, mes-edge/press3.

decimal.description: An amount or quantity as an exact decimal string, never a JSON number (ADR 0008).

quantity.description: A quantity that cannot be negative, as an exact decimal string.

dateTime.description: An ISO 8601 date-time with its offset from UTC (Z or +02:00).

code.description: An ERP code (company code, plant, area, line, work centre, cost centre, activity type).

documentNumber.description: An ERP document number, e.g. MO00000001.

operationNumber.description: An operation of a routing or order, e.g. 10. Topics write it with four digits (0010).

event.description: An event, not state: never retained, and its event_id is required.
